description: Save a watch on one compliance list (ZIPs, status, type, stacked) and get what changed daily or weekly by email and/or a signed webhook. Pass track (item keys) to follow items one by one: each closes on its own when the agency's data no longer lists it. Needs an API key. Rows past the first 10 in each delivery cost credits per 100.
name: watch_compliance
title: Set up a compliance alert
